title.en: It knows what you give it

brief.zh: 让模型修好这个 issue，再跑一次测试确认。
brief.en: Get the model to fix this issue, then run the tests to make sure.

t.zh: 你自己决定<wiki-ref to="context"></wiki-ref>里放什么，按下「调用」，看模型做了什么，再自己跑测试。
t.en: You decide what goes into the <wiki-ref to="context"></wiki-ref>, press Call, see what the model did, and run the tests yourself.

hint.zh: issue 里写了要改的文件名。
hint.en: The issue names the file to change.

after.zh: 模型只知道上下文里的东西；上下文外面的，它会编。
after.en: The model knows only what is in its context; what is outside, it makes up.
